articles.title: Letter: Support the Stormwater Drain Repair
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Jasper Drive use it every week.
Talia Jurgens, Stonebridge

articles.title: Eleanor Hartigan, 79, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Eleanor Hartigan for the many years of service to Hickory Ridge.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Hickory Ridge.
Born in Hickory Ridge in the years after the war, Eleanor Hartigan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Eleanor Hartigan died in January at home on Yardley Terrace, at the age of 79. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Millrace Improvement Group in his or her name.
